source_member_naming: TensorBoard source member names use a portable alias; the original source bytes are identified by SHA256 and size.
record_scope: Final training checkpoints, training scalar logs, update timing, actual training configuration and source attribution
configuration_representation: Actual configuration receipt serialized as JSON; callable entries are descriptive names; cloud project prefix is removed from path values.
metric_interpretation: Training scalars describe the optimization run. Metrics/twist/error_vel_xy is normalized by the configured command resampling time; its scale is not physical m/s RMSE. Training scalar values alone do not establish comparative task performance or real-robot transfer.
